python3 -c "
import os
os.makedirs('report/charts', exist_ok=True)

# ---- Chart 1: EU Inflation vs GDP Growth (line chart) ----
years = [2022, 2023, 2024]
inflation = [9.2, 6.4, 2.4]
growth = [3.4, 0.4, 0.9]

W, H = 800, 430
L, R, T, B = 70, 30, 60, 60
pw, ph = W - L - R, H - T - B
ymin, ymax = -1, 10.5

def sx(x):
    return L + pw * (x - years[0]) / (years[-1] - years[0])
def sy(v):
    return T + ph * (ymax - v) / (ymax - ymin)

svg = []
svg.append(f'<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"{W}\" height=\"{H}\" viewBox=\"0 0 {W} {H}\" font-family=\"Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif\">')
svg.append(f'<rect width=\"{W}\" height=\"{H}\" fill=\"#ffffff\"/>')
svg.append(f'<text x=\"{L}\" y=\"34\" font-size=\"22\" font-weight=\"bold\" fill=\"#1a1a2e\">The Soft Landing: Inflation Tamed, Growth Preserved</text>')
svg.append(f'<text x=\"{L}\" y=\"54\" font-size=\"13\" fill=\"#6b7280\">EU-27 annual averages, 2022-2024</text>')

# grid + y labels
for v in range(0, 11):
    y = sy(v)
    svg.append(f'<line x1=\"{L}\" y1=\"{y:.1f}\" x2=\"{W-R}\" y2=\"{y:.1f}\" stroke=\"#e8e8e8\" stroke-width=\"1\"/>')
    svg.append(f'<text x=\"{L-10}\" y=\"{y+4:.1f}\" font-size=\"12\" fill=\"#8d99ae\" text-anchor=\"end\">{v}%</text>')

# x labels
for i, yr in enumerate(years):
    x = sx(yr)
    svg.append(f'<text x=\"{x:.1f}\" y=\"{H-B+20}\" font-size=\"13\" fill=\"#4b5563\" text-anchor=\"middle\">{yr}</text>')

# inflation line (red)
pts = ' '.join(f'{sx(y):.1f},{sy(v):.1f}' for y, v in zip(years, inflation))
svg.append(f'<polyline points=\"{pts}\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"#e63946\" stroke-width=\"3.5\"/>')
for y, v in zip(years, inflation):
    cx, cy = sx(y), sy(v)
    svg.append(f'<circle cx=\"{cx:.1f}\" cy=\"{cy:.1f}\" r=\"5\" fill=\"#e63946\"/>')
    svg.append(f'<text x=\"{cx:.1f}\" y=\"{cy-12:.1f}\" font-size=\"13\" font-weight=\"bold\" fill=\"#e63946\" text-anchor=\"middle\">{v}%</text>')

# growth line (blue)
pts2 = ' '.join(f'{sx(y):.1f},{sy(v):.1f}' for y, v in zip(years, growth))
svg.append(f'<polyline points=\"{pts2}\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"#1f4e78\" stroke-width=\"3.5\"/>')
for y, v in zip(years, growth):
    cx, cy = sx(y), sy(v)
    svg.append(f'<circle cx=\"{cx:.1f}\" cy=\"{cy:.1f}\" r=\"5\" fill=\"#1f4e78\"/>')
    svg.append(f'<text x=\"{cx:.1f}\" y=\"{cy-12:.1f}\" font-size=\"13\" font-weight=\"bold\" fill=\"#1f4e78\" text-anchor=\"middle\">{v}%</text>')

# annotation
ax, ay = sx(2023), sy(6.4)
svg.append(f'<rect x=\"{ax+25}\" y=\"{ay-38}\" width=\"215\" height=\"34\" rx=\"6\" fill=\"#fef2f2\" stroke=\"#e63946\" stroke-width=\"1\"/>')
svg.append(f'<text x=\"{ax+35}\" y=\"{ay-17}\" font-size=\"12\" fill=\"#9f1239\">Inflation -6.8pp in 2 years</text>')

# legend
svg.append(f'<rect x=\"{W-320}\" y=\"12\" width=\"290\" height=\"34\" rx=\"6\" fill=\"#f9fafb\" stroke=\"#e5e7eb\"/>')
svg.append(f'<line x1=\"{W-305}\" y1=\"29\" x2=\"{W-275}\" y2=\"29\" stroke=\"#e63946\" stroke-width=\"3\"/>')
svg.append(f'<text x=\"{W-268}\" y=\"33\" font-size=\"13\" fill=\"#374151\">Inflation</text>')
svg.append(f'<line x1=\"{W-205}\" y1=\"29\" x2=\"{W-175}\" y2=\"29\" stroke=\"#1f4e78\" stroke-width=\"3\"/>')
svg.append(f'<text x=\"{W-168}\" y=\"33\" font-size=\"13\" fill=\"#374151\">Real GDP growth</text>')

svg.append('</svg>')
with open('report/charts/chart1_soft_landing.svg', 'w') as f:
    f.write('\n'.join(svg))
print('chart1 written, size:', os.path.getsize('report/charts/chart1_soft_landing.svg'))
"

import os
os.makedirs('report/charts', exist_ok=True)

# ---- Chart 1: EU Inflation vs GDP Growth (line chart) ----
years = [2022, 2023, 2024]
inflation = [9.2, 6.4, 2.4]
growth = [3.4, 0.4, 0.9]

W, H = 800, 430
L, R, T, B = 70, 30, 60, 60
pw, ph = W - L - R, H - T - B
ymin, ymax = -1, 10.5

def sx(x):
    return L + pw * (x - years[0]) / (years[-1] - years[0])
def sy(v):
    return T + ph * (ymax - v) / (ymax - ymin)

svg = []
svg.append(f'<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"{W}\" height=\"{H}\" viewBox=\"0 0 {W} {H}\" font-family=\"Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif\">')
svg.append(f'<rect width=\"{W}\" height=\"{H}\" fill=\"#ffffff\"/>')
svg.append(f'<text x=\"{L}\" y=\"34\" font-size=\"22\" font-weight=\"bold\" fill=\"#1a1a2e\">The Soft Landing: Inflation Tamed, Growth Preserved</text>')
svg.append(f'<text x=\"{L}\" y=\"54\" font-size=\"13\" fill=\"#6b7280\">EU-27 annual averages, 2022-2024</text>')

# grid + y labels
for v in range(0, 11):
    y = sy(v)
    svg.append(f'<line x1=\"{L}\" y1=\"{y:.1f}\" x2=\"{W-R}\" y2=\"{y:.1f}\" stroke=\"#e8e8e8\" stroke-width=\"1\"/>')
    svg.append(f'<text x=\"{L-10}\" y=\"{y+4:.1f}\" font-size=\"12\" fill=\"#8d99ae\" text-anchor=\"end\">{v}%</text>')

# x labels
for i, yr in enumerate(years):
    x = sx(yr)
    svg.append(f'<text x=\"{x:.1f}\" y=\"{H-B+20}\" font-size=\"13\" fill=\"#4b5563\" text-anchor=\"middle\">{yr}</text>')

# inflation line (red)
pts = ' '.join(f'{sx(y):.1f},{sy(v):.1f}' for y, v in zip(years, inflation))
svg.append(f'<polyline points=\"{pts}\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"#e63946\" stroke-width=\"3.5\"/>')
for y, v in zip(years, inflation):
    cx, cy = sx(y), sy(v)
    svg.append(f'<circle cx=\"{cx:.1f}\" cy=\"{cy:.1f}\" r=\"5\" fill=\"#e63946\"/>')
    svg.append(f'<text x=\"{cx:.1f}\" y=\"{cy-12:.1f}\" font-size=\"13\" font-weight=\"bold\" fill=\"#e63946\" text-anchor=\"middle\">{v}%</text>')

# growth line (blue)
pts2 = ' '.join(f'{sx(y):.1f},{sy(v):.1f}' for y, v in zip(years, growth))
svg.append(f'<polyline points=\"{pts2}\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"#1f4e78\" stroke-width=\"3.5\"/>')
for y, v in zip(years, growth):
    cx, cy = sx(y), sy(v)
    svg.append(f'<circle cx=\"{cx:.1f}\" cy=\"{cy:.1f}\" r=\"5\" fill=\"#1f4e78\"/>')
    svg.append(f'<text x=\"{cx:.1f}\" y=\"{cy-12:.1f}\" font-size=\"13\" font-weight=\"bold\" fill=\"#1f4e78\" text-anchor=\"middle\">{v}%</text>')

# annotation
ax, ay = sx(2023), sy(6.4)
svg.append(f'<rect x=\"{ax+25}\" y=\"{ay-38}\" width=\"215\" height=\"34\" rx=\"6\" fill=\"#fef2f2\" stroke=\"#e63946\" stroke-width=\"1\"/>')
svg.append(f'<text x=\"{ax+35}\" y=\"{ay-17}\" font-size=\"12\" fill=\"#9f1239\">Inflation -6.8pp in 2 years</text>')

# legend
svg.append(f'<rect x=\"{W-320}\" y=\"12\" width=\"290\" height=\"34\" rx=\"6\" fill=\"#f9fafb\" stroke=\"#e5e7eb\"/>')
svg.append(f'<line x1=\"{W-305}\" y1=\"29\" x2=\"{W-275}\" y2=\"29\" stroke=\"#e63946\" stroke-width=\"3\"/>')
svg.append(f'<text x=\"{W-268}\" y=\"33\" font-size=\"13\" fill=\"#374151\">Inflation</text>')
svg.append(f'<line x1=\"{W-205}\" y1=\"29\" x2=\"{W-175}\" y2=\"29\" stroke=\"#1f4e78\" stroke-width=\"3\"/>')
svg.append(f'<text x=\"{W-168}\" y=\"33\" font-size=\"13\" fill=\"#374151\">Real GDP growth</text>')

svg.append('</svg>')
with open('report/charts/chart1_soft_landing.svg', 'w') as f:
    f.write('\n'.join(svg))
print('chart1 written, size:', os.path.getsize('report/charts/chart1_soft_landing.svg'))
